ace-seeds-about-2026.title: About us
ace-seeds-about-2026.note: Current ACE Seeds official About page. Used to confirm Panama was included in ACE Seeds' first catalog in 2005 and to support breeder/seed-company context.

ace-seeds-about.title: About Us
ace-seeds-about.note: ACE Seeds公式沿革・entity確認。2012年のMalawi導入とACE Seedsのbreeder / seed company確認に使用。

ace-seeds-malawi.title: Malawi
ace-seeds-malawi.note: ACE Seeds公式Malawi品種ページ。Malawi由来P4 landrace、Old Malawi Killer × 3rd generation Malawis、香味、テルペン、原産地、breeder / seed company確認に使用。

ace-seeds-panama.title: Panama Regular
ace-seeds-panama.note: ACE Seeds official Panama page. Used for three-Panamanian-sativa lineage, F8-F12 designation, 100% sativa type, aroma, terpene profile, origin and visual morphology evidence.

ace-seeds-zamaldelica.title: Zamaldelica Regular
ace-seeds-zamaldelica.note: ACE Seeds公式Zamaldelica Regular品種ページ。F3 semi stabilized hybrid、100% sativa、Zamal x Malawi/Thai、Zamal母系のRéunion Island由来、作出説明、bouquet、詳細terpene profileを確認。

acs-og-kush-volatiles-2021.title: Identification of a New Family of Prenylated Volatile Sulfur Compounds in Cannabis Revealed by Comprehensive Two-Dimensional Gas Chromatography
acs-og-kush-volatiles-2021.note: Peer-reviewed volatile-compound study coauthored by Josh Del Rosso. It describes OG Kush as strongly pungent and fuel-like and associates that profile with high beta-myrcene and beta-caryophyllene. Used as corroboration, not as proof that every OG Kush lot shares one fixed terpene profile.

barneys-farm-dr-grinspoon.title: Dr Grinspoon Strain
barneys-farm-dr-grinspoon.note: Barney's Farm公式Dr Grinspoon品種ページ。Heirloom Sativa Strain、100% sativa、Dr. Lester Grinspoonへの敬意による命名、sumac / lemon / tangy / tropical fruitのaromaを確認。親品種は公式ページで開示されていないためlineage parentageはunknown扱い。

david-downs-wedding-cake-2026.title: Seed Junky Genetics recuts Wedding Cake into Cake Straws
david-downs-wedding-cake-2026.note: Recent specialist article based on direct conversation with Seed Junky co-founder J Beezy. It identifies Seed Junky Genetics with Wedding Cake and describes Wedding Cake as Triangle Kush x Animal Mints. The lineage wording is the author's statement rather than a verbatim lineage quote from J Beezy, so it is corroborating evidence rather than standalone A-level proof for parentage.

dna-chocolope-256.title: Chocolope 256 Fem Cannabis Seeds
dna-chocolope-256.note: Primary DNA Genetics product source for Chocolope 256. It identifies the cross as Lemon Skunk 256 (Emerald Cup Winning Cut) × Chocolope, classifies the cultivar as Sativa-dominant (70% Sativa / 30% Indica in the product description), gives cultivar-level aroma descriptors, and names Myrcene, Beta-caryophyllene, and Limonene. The page is not a lot-specific laboratory COA, so terpene confidence should remain conservative. No named breeding generation such as F1/F2/BX is stated.

dna-eu-cataract-kush.title: Cataract Kush
dna-eu-cataract-kush.note: Current DNA Genetics European catalog page. It identifies Cataract Kush as a combination of OG Kush and L.A. Confidential, lists 99% Indica / 1% Sativa, and states that the strain was years in the making.

dna-eu-the-og-18.title: The OG #18
dna-eu-the-og-18.note: Current DNA Genetics European catalog page. It identifies The #18 as a selection from previously released feminized OG Kush seeds, says it was re-feminized, labels the genetics as OG Kush S1, describes sour/fuel characteristics, and lists historical awards.

dna-strawberry-banana-s1.title: Strawberry Banana S1
dna-strawberry-banana-s1.note: Primary source for the S1 designation, self-pollination description, breeder description, aroma and reported terpene claims.

dutch-passion-durban-poison.title: Durban Poison
dutch-passion-durban-poison.note: Dutch Passion official cultivar page used for sativa classification, Durban × Unknown Indica lineage, aroma, morphology and origin context.

dutch-passion-frisian-duck.title: Frisian Duck®
dutch-passion-frisian-duck.note: Dutch Passion公式Frisian Duck品種ページ。Frisian Dew x DucksFoot、hybrid表記、長年の選抜育種、特徴的な葉形、spicy / fresh forest / pine / citrus / fruity系の香りを確認。

dutch-passion-shaman-story.title: Shaman cannabis strain story and grow tips
dutch-passion-shaman-story.note: Dutch Passion official cultivar history page. Used for Purple #1 male × early Skunk female, sativa-dominant F1 designation, Dutch outdoor breeding-program history/origin and structural visual evidence.

dutch-passion-shaman.title: Shaman
dutch-passion-shaman.note: Dutch Passion official Shaman product page. Used for Purple #1 × Skunk lineage, sativa-dominant identity, F1/regular-feminised product context, aroma and visual colour evidence.

fischedick-og-kush-terpenoids-2017.title: Identification of Terpenoid Chemotypes Among High (-)-trans-Delta9-Tetrahydrocannabinol-Producing Cannabis sativa L. Cultivars
fischedick-og-kush-terpenoids-2017.note: Peer-reviewed terpene study including samples labeled OG Kush. The OG Kush group was characterized primarily by myrcene with similar or somewhat lower limonene, while beta-caryophyllene and related terpenoids also contributed to the group profile. Cultivar-name identity limitations remain.

ghsc-super-lemon-haze.title: Super Lemon Haze
ghsc-super-lemon-haze.note: Primary Green House Seed Co. source. Confirms Lemon Skunk × Super Silver Haze, 70% Sativa / 30% Indica, lemon/citrus/Haze/woody/pine sensory description, reported β-Caryophyllene/D-Limonene/Terpinolene profile, late-2000s breeding context, and listed awards.

high-times-socal-2018-wedding-cake.title: Winners of the 2018 SoCal Cannabis Cup
high-times-socal-2018-wedding-cake.note: High Times event result lists Wedding Cake by New Amsterdam Naturals with Cannastar as 1st Place, Best Hybrid Flower. This supports the cultivar's competition history and hybrid classification, not breeder attribution.

hsc-california-octane.title: California Octane Seeds
hsc-california-octane.note: Humboldt Seed Company official California Octane product page. Used for Dream Queen × I-369 × Papaya lineage, S3 designation, indica-leaning hybrid type, gas/guava/crème aroma and dense trichome-rich flower evidence.

humboldt-csi-wedding-cake-s1.title: Wedding Cake S1
humboldt-csi-wedding-cake-s1.note: Primary official source for the Wedding Cake S1 product name, Wedding Cake × Wedding Cake designation, feminized seed listing, and Humboldt CSI association. The page does not identify the exact Wedding Cake cut or provide cultivar-level aroma, terpene, or TYPE data.

humboldt-seed-company-about.title: About
humboldt-seed-company-about.note: Humboldt Seed Company official About page. Used to confirm company identity and breeding/seed-company context. Company founding location is not used as proof of California Octane cultivar origin.

josh-d-og-kush-official.title: The OG Kush Story / Josh D Legacy
josh-d-og-kush-official.note: Primary source from Josh Del Rosso (Josh D). Records OG Kush reaching Los Angeles from Florida in 1996, Josh D's central role in preserving and spreading the lineage, and his description of the original OG aroma as Pine-Sol, kerosene and earthy gas. Does not establish biological parentage.

leafly-bubble-gum.note: Migrated from legacy sources.js without adding new claims.

leafly-cataract-kush.title: Cataract Kush strain
leafly-cataract-kush.note: Leafly cultivar page used for reported flavor descriptors and Certified Strain Science terpene ordering. These are treated conservatively and not as a cultivar-wide lot-specific COA.

leafly-dr-grinspoon.title: Dr. Grinspoon strain
leafly-dr-grinspoon.note: 専門データベース補助資料。Dr. GrinspoonのterpeneとしてTerpinolene / Myrcene / Pineneを確認。公式一次情報ではないためterpene claimはconfidence Bとする。

leafly-og-18.title: OG #18
leafly-og-18.note: Specialist database used conservatively for aliases, hybrid classification, reported flavor descriptors, and reported terpene names. Terpene claims are not treated as lot-specific laboratory data.

leafly-og-history.title: OG Kush family genealogy
leafly-og-history.note: Migrated from legacy sources.js without adding new claims.

leafly-strawberry-banana.title: Strawberry Banana
leafly-strawberry-banana.note: Independent specialist reference for Original Strawberry Banana; not treated as S1-specific laboratory evidence.

leafly-wedding-cake-2019.title: And Leafly's 2019 strain of the year is...
leafly-wedding-cake-2019.note: Leafly reports that breeder J Beezy of Seed Junky Genetics listed Wedding Cake as a phenotype of Triangle Mints, while noting the older GSC x Cherry Pie belief. Secondary specialist source; breeder's original Instagram post was not directly archived here.

leafly-wedding-cake.title: Wedding Cake
leafly-wedding-cake.note: Migrated from legacy sources.js without adding new claims.

seed-junky-official.title: Seed Junky | Where the Hunt Begins
seed-junky-official.note: Official Seed Junky site identifies Wedding Cake among its pheno-hunted cultivars. Supports breeder attribution and cultivar existence, but not the exact parentage or Triangle Mints #23 designation.

seedfinder-cataract-kush.title: Cataract Kush (DNA Genetics Seeds)
seedfinder-cataract-kush.note: SeedFinder cultivar record used as an independent specialist-database cross-check for the L.A. Confidential and OG Kush parent combination.

seedfinder-malawi.note: SeedFinderによるMalawi / ACE Seedsの独立照合。CannaConnectionとSeed-Cityはsourceファイルへ追加しない。

seedfinder-the-og-18.title: The OG #18 (Reserva Privada)
seedfinder-the-og-18.note: Specialist database corroborating Reserva Privada attribution, feminized-seed status, OG Kush background, flowering description, and major award records.

serious-seeds-kali-mist.title: Kali Mist Strain
serious-seeds-kali-mist.note: Serious Seeds official cultivar page used for sativa classification, undisclosed pedigree boundary, aroma, morphology and breeding history.

serious-seeds-warlock.note: Serious Seeds official cultivar page used for mostly-indica classification, Skunk/Afghani lineage, history, aroma and morphology.

humboldt-seed-company.note: Humboldt Seed Company official product and About pages identify the company as the breeder/seed company for California Octane.

reserva-privada.note: DNA Genetics-associated breeding and seed line. The OG #18 is listed under Reserva Privada on DNA Genetics' current European catalog and historical Reserva Privada material.
